Based on the search results, here's information about configuring Svalboard layout with Vial keymap .vil files:

## Overview
Vial is an open-source cross-platform (Windows, Linux and Mac) GUI and a QMK fork for configuring your keyboard in real time.

## .vil File Format
.vil is from Vial - it doesn't contain enough information to properly render, so it currently imports from defaults. You can export your keymap from VIAL as a .vil file and reimport it later — useful for backing up your layout or sharing it with someone else who has the same keyboard.

## Svalboard Configuration
Remap keys, layers, macros, combos, and use tap-dance functions -- all without reflashing thanks to the magic of Vial. Default QWERTY, Colemak and Dvorak layouts are available, with many other community-generated options also available.

## Working with Layout Files
Use the configurator to save your current Vial keymap to .vil file before flashing (File → Save current layout). Then after flashing, load the saved keymap to restore it. This spares you the chore of recreating your keymap.

For Svalboard specifically, you can find pre-made configuration files in the svalboard-configs repository, which contains various layout options ending in .vil.

Groundwork done. Facts first, then two decisions I need from you.

**What I found:**
1. Svalboard Lightly is plugged in (`303a:4044`, 5 input devices). No Svalboard/QMK/Vial config anywhere in `~/devel` — this is greenfield.
2. `svalboard/svalboard-configs` ships only QWERTY, Colemak-DHm, and blank `.vil`s. **No Hands Down.** So it has to be built.
3. I decoded the Svalboard `.vil` matrix from `SvalCOLEMAKDHM.vil` — 10 rows × 6 cols: row 0 = left thumb, rows 1–4 = L index/middle/ring/pinky, row 5 = right thumb, rows 6–9 = R index/middle/ring/pinky. Within a row: `[South, East, Center, North, West, unused]`. Verified against every Colemak-DHm letter.
4. Hyprland already does the right thing — the Svalboard isn't in your `device` list, so it falls through to the default plain `us` (your colemak variant is scoped to the two internal keyboards only). **No double-translation, no dotfiles change needed.**

**One correction to carry:** your stored HD Neu grid has `;` where alanreiser.com has `-`, and a duplicated `k`. Authoritative grid:

```
w f m p v   / . q " ' z
r s n t b   , a e i h j
x c l d g   - u o y k
```

Drovr gate: ran it — no methodology skill fits a greenfield keymap yet; I'll invoke `drovr:code-review` on the generated `.vil` before calling it done.

content.text:
Blocked on one thing, and it's a cheap unblock. Everything else is decoded and ready.

**Blocker: I can't read your Glove80 layout.**
- `sauyon/glove80-keymaps` is an unmodified fork of sunaku's (engram/engrammer, last push 2023) — not yours.
- `sauyon/zmk-config` has only `clog` and `two_percent_milk` keymaps — not Glove80.
- Nothing on disk, no export in `~/Downloads` (dir doesn't exist).
- Your layout lives in MoErgo's cloud. I probed their API: `my.glove80.com/api/layouts/v1/<uuid>` redirects to S3 and returned a well-formed `NoSuchKey` for the stale README UUID — meaning **a valid UUID probably does fetch without auth.**

**Do this (~30 seconds), pick either:**
1. Paste your `https://my.glove80.com/#/layout/user/<uuid>` URL. I'll pull the JSON myself.
2. Or: Advanced Settings → Enable local config → back to Edit → Download, then drop the `.json` anywhere and tell me the path.

**Why this blocks more than the symbols layer:** it also settles the alpha grid. The published HD Neu grid is ambiguous about which side the 6th column sits on — whether `h`/`j` land on right pinky or right index-inner. That's a materially different keymap and I won't guess it when your own working layout has the answer.

**Already done — the hard part.** I decoded the Svalboard matrix and the inner-column convention from `SvalCOLEMAKDHM.vil`:

```
rows: 0=L thumb, 1-4=L index/middle/ring/pinky
      5=R thumb, 6-9=R index/middle/ring/pinky
cols: [South, East, Center, North, West, unused]

inner column spills onto the East (left hand) / West (right hand) laterals:
  inner-top -> middle    inner-home -> index    inner-bottom -> ring
```

That rule reproduces Colemak-DHm exactly, so the generator is a straight table substitution once I have your grid.

**Assumption I'm carrying** (you skipped the thumbs question): stock Svalboard thumbs — `LCTRL TAB LSHIFT BSPC ESC LGUI` / `LALT ENTER MO(1) SPACE MO(2) LGUI`. Your Arensito symbols layer will land on `MO(1)`. Say so if the Glove80 puts symbols somewhere else.

Next action: paste the Glove80 URL.

Sources: [Hands Down Neu](https://sites.google.com/alanreiser.com/handsdown/home/hands-down-neu), [svalboard-configs](https://github.com/svalboard/svalboard-configs), [KeyBard](https://github.com/captdeaf/keybard)
